queries.sql: SELECT DISTINCT dataset_id,policy_version,product_master_sha256 FROM workspace.medshield_gold.sales_restart_fact_candidate VERSION AS OF 19

SELECT COUNT(*) AS records,
    COUNT_IF(is_provisional_product_demand_eligible) AS provisional_records,
    COUNT_IF(is_provisional_product_demand_eligible AND (is_low_trust_2017 OR is_historical_backfill_candidate OR product_scope_status <> 'PRODUCT_MASTER_PENDING' OR quantity <= 0)) AS invalid_predecessor_provisional,
    COUNT_IF(is_approved_medical_demand_eligible AND (NOT is_medical_product_approved OR is_contract_label OR transaction_evidence='adjusted_estimated_source' OR item_kind<>'physical_product' OR canonical_sku IS NULL OR unit_of_measure IS NULL OR is_low_trust_2017 OR is_historical_backfill_candidate OR quantity <= 0)) AS invalid_approved_demand
    FROM workspace.medshield_gold.sales_restart_fact_candidate VERSION AS OF 19

SELECT normalized_product,product_scope_status,COUNT(*) AS records FROM workspace.medshield_gold.sales_restart_fact_candidate VERSION AS OF 19
    WHERE is_provisional_product_demand_eligible GROUP BY normalized_product,product_scope_status
